originality.rationale: EXACT PRIOR COVERAGE FOUND despite nonisomorphic source graphs. The published full rook-graph H(2,4)=K4 square K4 neighborhood-complex result computes H1=Z/2 and the same entire face vector. A fresh incidence-preserving bijection between the 16 Shrikhande vertices and 16 rook vertices, with independent permutation of the 16 neighborhood facets, proves the two open-neighborhood hypergraphs and thus the simplicial complexes are ISOMORPHIC. With row-major Z4² labels the vertex permutation is [10,3,11,2,1,4,0,5,7,14,6,15,12,9,13,8], while the neighborhood-center permutation is [0,8,1,9,6,2,7,3,13,5,12,4,11,15,10,14]. Each of the 16 images of a Shrikhande open neighborhood was exactly checked to equal the rook neighborhood at the mapped center. Therefore the published rook homology theorem IMPLIES the assigned Shrikhande H1 result, even though the graphs are nonisomorphic (their neighborhood-complex incidence hypergraphs are isomorphic).
